classification: Frozen mechanical catalog representation repair; no new DDL/constraint/authorization/transaction decisions. Seven expected literal expressions match actual approved SQL catalog, differing only case/quoting/charset rendering/grouping parentheses. All non-parenthesis tokens compare equal in static diagnostic; runtime regression required. Do NOT change any normalization algorithm, CHECK enforcement, accepted names, locks or drift behaviour.

replacements.name: chk_chat_typed_admission_digest
replacements.old: ((REGEXP_LIKE(request_digest,CAST('^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AS CHAR CHARSET binary))) AND (REGEXP_LIKE(body_digest,CAST('^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AS CHAR CHARSET binary))))
replacements.new: (regexp_like(request_digest,cast('^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary)) and regexp_like(body_digest,cast('^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary)))

replacements.name: chk_chat_typed_admission_reply
replacements.old: (intent='DISCUSSION' AND pending_question_id IS NULL) OR (intent='CLARIFICATION_REPLY' AND parent_outcome_id IS NOT NULL AND pending_question_id IS NOT NULL)
replacements.new: (((intent = 'DISCUSSION') and (pending_question_id is null)) or ((intent = 'CLARIFICATION_REPLY') and (parent_outcome_id is not null) and (pending_question_id is not null)))

replacements.name: chk_chat_typed_outcome_json
replacements.new: (json_valid(binding_json) and json_valid(facts_json) and json_valid(outcome_json) and json_valid(source_catalog_json))

replacements.name: chk_chat_typed_pending_version
replacements.old: (state='OPEN' AND state_version=0 AND reply_request_id IS NULL AND reply_idempotency_key IS NULL AND reply_body_digest IS NULL) OR (state='ANSWERED' AND state_version=1 AND reply_request_id IS NOT NULL AND reply_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_LIKE(reply_body_digest,CAST('^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AS CHAR CHARSET binary)))
replacements.new: (((state = 'OPEN') and (state_version = 0) and (reply_request_id is null) and (reply_idempotency_key is null) and (reply_body_digest is null)) or ((state = 'ANSWERED') and (state_version = 1) and (reply_request_id is not null) and (reply_idempotency_key is not null) and regexp_like(reply_body_digest,cast('^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary))))

replacements.name: chk_chat_typed_proposal_parent
replacements.old: (parent_request_id IS NULL AND parent_step_id IS NULL) OR (parent_request_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_step_id IS NOT NULL)
replacements.new: (((parent_request_id is null) and (parent_step_id is null)) or ((parent_request_id is not null) and (parent_step_id is not null)))
